title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Clueless' and 'Eighth Grade' are highlighted as classic and contemporary films now available on Netflix.
New releases include 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' on Paramount+ and 'You, Me & Tuscany' on Peacock.
'Star Trek: Strange New Worlds' Season 4 begins on Paramount+, recommended by Boston.com's editor Peter Chianca.

title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Kevin Klimas reported an 8-foot Bigfoot sighting in Voluntown, Connecticut on July 5, 2026.
The Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization verified Klimas's sighting as credible, among 126 such reports since 1994 in New England.
BU's Eva Garrett claims scientific evidence of Bigfoot's existence is lacking, correlating sightings with black bear populations.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Margo Howard, daughter of Ann Landers, and former Dear Prudence columnist for Slate, passed away at 86.
Howard, an advice columnist, was known for her tough love approach, influencing fellow columnist Meredith Goldstein.
Goldstein reflects on Howard's impactful life advice, encouraging balance between grief and finding happiness post-loss.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle struck out a career-high 14 in the Red Sox's 13-1 victory over the Athletics.
Red Sox extended their winning streak to nine games, accumulating 15 hits against Athletics.
Rookie Raymond Burgos made his Red Sox debut with three scoreless innings and two strikeouts.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez engage in competitive training camp battles at Patriots training, sharpening each other's skills.
Gonzalez uses intentional trash talk to prepare Brown for challenges from top cornerbacks this season.
New England Patriots have reportedly offered Gonzalez a lucrative contract extension amid his impressive training camp performance.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman will begin a rehab assignment with the Triple-A Worcester Red Sox on Saturday.
Rutschman was traded to the Red Sox from the Orioles in exchange for three prospects and Carlos Narvaez.
The Red Sox are in the AL's second wild-card spot with a 31-5 record since June 25.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' (2026) is now streaming on Paramount+, featuring Aang and an ancient warrior.
'Ted Lasso' Season 4 introduces a new women's team under coach Ted Lasso, streaming on Apple TV.
'You, Me & Tuscany' starring Halle Bailey and Regé-Jean Page is streaming on Peacock.

title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Garrett Crochet has been on the injured list since April due to left shoulder inflammation and subsequent lat tightness.
Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy suggests Crochet is unlikely to start, but may return in a bullpen role in 2026.
Crochet previously pitched in the bullpen for the White Sox and is open to a relief role to help the Red Sox this season.

title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: A ball python, named 'Tippy', was found near Ellington Street in Dorchester on Wednesday.
The python was left in a cage near community garden beds and discovered by residents and staff.
Boston Animal Care and Control is caring for the snake in Roslindale and seeking its owner.

title: Tommy DeVito bests Drake Maye, and other takeaways from Patriots’ training camp scrimmage
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Team Blue, led by Tommy DeVito, defeated Team White with a 22-15 score in the Patriots' training camp scrimmage.
DeMario Douglas excelled for Team Blue, catching six passes and scoring two touchdowns, including a 50-yard catch.
Injury updates: Cornerback Carlton Davis is expected to return late next week; left tackle Will Campbell to play after the weekend.
